Findings

1. **The scenes**, line 146, scene 1, the beats (change 22). The pack counts confetti as a reward for playing, with no exception on the kid side (pack: game-design, no-rewards-for-playing.md), and this confetti has no cause in the world, so it is a prize for finishing and not a consequence. Replace the clause
   `and as it lands the hill wobbles, the whale blows, the troop that waits bounces where it stands, the ball goes up, and confetti in the troop's colour bursts over the friends and flutters down;`
   with
   `and as it lands the hill wobbles, the whale blows, the troop that waits bounces where it stands, and the ball goes up;`
   (The art guide's confetti lines, its confetti voice and the game follow the sheet.)

2. **The scenes**, lines 148 and 150 (change 26 against the unchanged saved list of scene 2; ruling 12, the near case of a first showing). Change 26 has a first showing start when the child's troop has walked in, about three seconds after the step-in starts, while line 148 still writes its mark at the start of the step-in, so a game put away in between would never show the idea.
   Line 148, replace
   `` `slips` (none), `finished` (false), `rng`, and, when a first showing plays inside it, that mark in `shown`. ``
   with
   `` `slips` (none), `finished` (false) and `rng`. A first showing that plays inside the step-in is not saved here: its mark in `shown` is written when the showing itself starts. ``
   Line 150, replace
   `Every first showing that does not play at the opening plays inside the step-in at which its idea arrives: when the child's troop has walked in, or before it walks in where that troop is three.`
   with
   `Every first showing that does not play at the opening plays inside the step-in at which its idea arrives: when the child's troop has walked in, or before it walks in where that troop is three. Its mark is written when the showing itself starts and not at the start of the step-in: a game put away in between is found with the new troop in its place and no showing playing, and the showing, still owed, plays inside the next step-in that brings its idea again, a troop of two or three for one for each, a sky with a bunch of more than one balloon for a bunch for a whole troop.`

3. **The scenes**, line 150 (change 26). "Seen whole" contradicts line 144, where any touch ends a scene, and the same sentence's "the child can begin at once"; what is meant is that it is drawn and not sounded. Replace
   `that first showing is seen whole and is silent, since no sound plays before the first touch.`
   with
   `that first showing is drawn in full and makes no sound, since no sound plays before the first touch, and any touch ends it as it ends every scene.`
